footer.blurb: Marketplace, pricing and listing guidance for e-commerce sellers — with a hard floor that never recommends a loss-making price.

home.badge: Live marketplace intelligence for Indian sellers
home.headlineAfter: and what to charge — with evidence.
home.subhead: Bodha AI reads live comparable listings on Amazon, Flipkart and Snapdeal, scores each marketplace on profit, demand and competition, then tells you the platform, the price and the listing copy. It will never recommend a price that loses you money.
home.howLead: This is not a generic “Amazon is best” guess. Every recommendation is computed from your costs plus live search results, using the same formula for every marketplace you select.
home.how1Body: We open each marketplace’s search page for your product title and read the top ~20 comparable prices, ratings and review counts.
home.how2Body: Break-even = cost ÷ (1 − commission) + shipping. The recommended price is never below this floor.
home.how3Body: Fit score = 40% profit + 30% low competition + 30% demand. Platforms are ranked by this score — the top one is the recommendation.
home.how4Body: The report lists listing counts, market ranges, fees and a plain-language why for each marketplace, so you can see the comparison, not just the winner.
home.featuresLead: Upload a product once. Bodha AI handles the marketplace, the price and the copy — and shows why.
home.feat1Body: Amazon, Flipkart, Snapdeal and Alibaba side by side on commission, demand, competition and the profit you actually keep.
home.feat2Body: Ideal price from the median of live comparable listings, clamped to a break-even floor so you never sell at a loss.
home.feat3Body: Title, description and keywords rewritten for marketplace search, in the language you selected.
home.guaranteeTitle: We will never tell you to sell at a loss.
home.guaranteeBody: Every recommendation is clamped to a break-even floor from your manufacturing cost, the marketplace commission and shipping. When the going market rate sits below that floor, Bodha AI says so instead of quietly suggesting a cheaper price.
home.previewNote: Illustration of a scored comparison — your report uses live listings for your product.
home.seoTitle: Amazon, Flipkart and Snapdeal seller tools in one report
home.seoLead: Bodha AI is an India marketplace pricing software for ecommerce sellers who need a live product research tool — not another generic blog post about “how to sell on Amazon India”.
home.seoWhoTitle: Built for Indian D2C and reseller teams
home.seoWhoBody: If you sell electronics accessories, apparel, home & kitchen, beauty or toys, upload a photo or title and get a marketplace comparison, break-even price and SEO listing copy for Amazon.in, Flipkart and Snapdeal.
home.seoWhereTitle: Where to sell and what to charge
home.seoWhereBody: See competitor listings, buyer review themes, Google Trends demand by Indian state, and platform benefits like Prime, Flipkart Assured and lower Snapdeal commission — then export a PDF your team can share.
home.pricingTitle: Start free. Analyse six products every month.
home.pricingLead: Create an account and get 6 product analyses per month. Need more? Subscribe for $10 / month via Razorpay test checkout.

report.fitCaption: Weighted 40% profit, 30% low competition, 30% demand. Higher is better.
report.profitCaption: What you keep at your selling price after commission, shipping and manufacturing cost.
report.listingLead: Rewritten for marketplace search. Copy each block straight into your listing form.
report.evidenceLead: The winner is the highest fit score among platforms that returned listings. Fit is not a vibe — it is a weighted score of three measured inputs.
report.evidenceVs: {{name}} scored {{score}} vs {{other}} at {{otherScore}}. Higher profit after fees, stronger demand, or lighter competition is what moved the rank — not a default preference for any one site.
report.evidenceReasonProfit: Higher net profit after commission and shipping.
report.evidenceReasonDemand: Stronger demand, measured from review volume on live listings.
report.evidenceReasonListings: More comparable live listings ({{count}}) to base the median on.
report.evidenceReasonFloor: Loss protection kept the price at break-even instead of chasing a cheaper market.
report.evidenceUnavailableSkip: Platforms with no listings are excluded from the ranking so they cannot win by default.
